title: 1986 Sportflics Decade Greats Trivia Quiz Card #50 Bob Feller Lenticular
condition_description: Excellent: light corner wear. See photos.
description:
1986 Sportflics Decade Greats trivia card #50 - lenticular 3-D front that flips between a baseball diamond and the trivia question. Q: Which Hall of Famer gave up the most walks in one season in the A.L.? A: Bob Feller (208 in 1938). Back also covers the 1972 All-Star Game won by Joe Morgan's single.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
